name: code-composer
description: Deterministic, model-free music composition and rendering for AI agents and programmable workflows.

interface.longDescription: An agent-directed, model-free music composition and rendering system that keeps musical intent editable as canonical Music IR and deterministically produces audio, MIDI, exchange packages, and production handoff files.
defaultPrompt: Use Code Composer to compose an original editable music piece from this brief and render a deterministic reference mix.
Use Code Composer to revise this composition while preserving explicit musical intent and prepare MIDI, stems, or a delivery package.
